free_tier.stated: Fully decentralized, statically built P2P VPN on libp2p. No central server; peers discover each other via DHT. Supports file transfer and sharing TCP services between peers without a VPN interface. Apache 2.0 License. Written in Go.

egress.terms: No hosted allowance exists: the software runs on a host that is supplied separately.; ingress: tcp+udp

record.binding_note: software only: no hosted endpoint is offered, so any egress it provides begins with a host that a user must get from a compute provider. libp2p P2P VPN over a DHT.
